actions.reason: RegexTokenizer._encode_ordinary now encodes all distinct uncached chunks of a call in one batch (when there are at least 32 and _encode_chunk isn't overridden). The chunks are latin-1 strings joined with a separator code point above every token id. No merge pair contains the separator, so no merge can cross from one chunk into the next. The cached rank-order plan is then applied with one str.replace per merge, skipping merges whose two tokens are absent. This is the same equivalence argument _apply_merges_str already relies on for long sequences. The plan builder is factored out as _get_str_plan, and it falls back to the per-chunk path when the plan conditions don't hold. Equivalence identical; encode_ir ratio 0.9835.
